newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's CNAC mulls Hong Kong listing -- BZW.
newsitem.headline: China's CNAC mulls Hong Kong listing -- BZW.

text.p: Chinese state-owned aviation group China National Aviation Corp (CNAC) is considering a listing on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong, an executive at BZW Asia Ltd said on Wednesday.

BZW has carried out a number of financing deals concerning CNAC and was exploring all sort of options, including a possible listing, with the company, BZW corporate and project finance director Nicholas Andrews told Reuters.
"A listing is one of the options," he said.
But Andrews declined to confirm local newspaper reports that CNAC applied to the exchange for a listing last month.
"We won't confirm we are seeking a listing at the moment," Andrews said. "Perhaps in the next month or so we might know what's happening with more certainty."
CNAC officials were not immediately available for comment.
CNAC is the largest single shareholder in local carrier Hong Kong Dragon Airlines (Dragonair), after buying 35.86 percent of the company last year.
The chairman of the state-owned group, Wang Guixiang, is also chairman of Dragonair and Air Macau.
